label: copy-phase echo of w/x (and l) in mid-to-late recall positions
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never during original tokens or at <DEL>), and only when the input token is a repeat (in_first=0), i.e. the model fed back a token it already saw. Strongly token-selective on the fed-back input: w (11x lift, 40% of mass) and x (9x, 30%), then l, h, m more weakly. Rate rises with position: almost nothing at recall_idx 0-2, increasing to about 9% of steps at recall_idx 8, so long sequences (L=9) carry 58% of mass. Top activations are all w or x inputs in the middle-to-late copy phase. Precision is low: most copy-phase w/x inputs do not cross threshold. The previous token (a, q, t, v, y preceding) raises the rate, but adding it does not improve F1. Does not fire on first occurrences or on most other letters or digits.
